assumptions: Rate method: assumed_net_rate
Pointing: ideal_pointing
Service: Assumed finite six-hour educational service; no operator allocation
Real matched DE421 SPICE states and published LOLA terrain grids; assumed hardware, service, pointing and net radio rates.
Generation is the minimum of endpoint and midpoint samples per 60-second bin, held constant by assumption; no continuous power guarantee.
Contacts require clear endpoint and midpoint finite-segment samples per 60-second bin with 30-second outer guards; unsampled short events may be missed.
Same-epoch geometric rays omit retarded endpoint geometry; a positive constant upper-model delay is separately applied to receiver service and byte arrival.
Constant contact delay uses maximum sampled geometric range plus 60 seconds at an assumed 12 km/s range-rate bound.
Terrain above the reference sphere is bounded by an assumed 12 km global envelope; low-altitude finite ray samples use real numerical DEM values.
Fixed-panel center-ray projection, sampled uniform Sun disk and same-ray spherical Earth eclipse mask; no temperature or self-shadowing model.
Synthetic relay conics omit nonspherical gravity, third bodies and radiation pressure; they are not operational frozen or libration-point orbits.
Whole dataset uses direct contacts or one selected lunar store-and-forward relay; Earth-orbit relays disabled.
Payload durations rounded upward to an event-grid boundary; padded payload occupancy consumes declared radio power.
Radio conflicts and electrical loads conservatively reserve every intersected event bin.
Acquisition and teardown use the terminal TX or RX electrical draw respectively.
Relay buffer reserves a complete chunk at reception start and releases it after outgoing payload completion.
Ground sink retains all received chunks with finite configured station storage.
Policy: satisfy deadline and constraints, then fewer relay hops, earlier final arrival, lower lander communications energy.
SYNTHETIC external relay power assumed sufficient only during declared service; battery/base loads not modeled
Ground stations use externally powered service; station battery/base loads are outside the frozen profile.

limitations: Registration is applied only for latitude -90 to -87.5 degrees in the corrected representation, based on four grid features and 48 height checks at the detailed mesh level; this is not an all-location or all-LOD accuracy guarantee.
The 3.54 m grid-resolution allowance does not bound continuous terrain-peak localization between samples.
Only the root and control tile fingerprints are checked at runtime; other streamed content is not completely checksum-pinned.
LOLA reference and mesh may share source observations. Independent extraction validates the display conversion, not independent absolute geodesy.
Unmodified streamed coordinates remain unregistered. Numerical DEM quality and coverage are independent of rendering.
No spacecraft ephemeris is invented for the synthetic contact-only relay fixture.
registration.tolerance_justification: Declared before corrected-scene landmark queries: 10 m relative display tolerance for the pinned 5 m source grid and detailed 5.21 m mesh. Resolved grid-feature residual plus a 3.54 m grid-resolution allowance must pass. This is a discrete relative-registration acceptance test, not a bound on continuous-peak localization, absolute navigation accuracy, or uncertainty probability.
registration.transform_meaning: Moon-centered DE421 mean-Earth Cartesian source columns map identically to the corrected renderer. The streamed asset vertices are first converted by the versioned engine display conversion; this identity never applies to raw ion tiles.

geoid.redistribution: Local acquisition only; grid and tile binaries are excluded from source commits and run packages
geoid.usage: Reverse the observed terrestrial height term in the streamed representation, not an Earth correction to lunar analysis

renderer_conversion.parameter_derivation: 261943 vertices in 240 tiles; height-independent geodetic constraints from quantized texture coordinates; no terrain-height offset fitted
renderer_conversion.purpose: Display-only reversal of the observed tile ingestion conversion; never a lunar physics datum
renderer_conversion.tolerance_scope: Relative display registration against the pinned numerical reference; not absolute lunar navigation accuracy

assumptions: Rate method: assumed_net_rate
Pointing: ideal_pointing
Service: Assumed finite six-hour educational service; no operator allocation
Real matched DE421 SPICE states and published LOLA terrain grids; assumed hardware, service, pointing and net radio rates.
Generation is the minimum of endpoint and midpoint samples per 60-second bin, held constant by assumption; no continuous power guarantee.
Contacts require clear endpoint and midpoint finite-segment samples per 60-second bin with 30-second outer guards; unsampled short events may be missed.
Same-epoch geometric rays omit retarded endpoint geometry; a positive constant upper-model delay is separately applied to receiver service and byte arrival.
Constant contact delay uses maximum sampled geometric range plus 60 seconds at an assumed 12 km/s range-rate bound.
Terrain above the reference sphere is bounded by an assumed 12 km global envelope; low-altitude finite ray samples use real numerical DEM values.
Fixed-panel center-ray projection, sampled uniform Sun disk and same-ray spherical Earth eclipse mask; no temperature or self-shadowing model.
Synthetic relay conics omit nonspherical gravity, third bodies and radiation pressure; they are not operational frozen or libration-point orbits.
Whole dataset uses direct contacts or one selected lunar store-and-forward relay; Earth-orbit relays disabled.
Payload durations rounded upward to an event-grid boundary; padded payload occupancy consumes declared radio power.
Radio conflicts and electrical loads conservatively reserve every intersected event bin.
Acquisition and teardown use the terminal TX or RX electrical draw respectively.
Relay buffer reserves a complete chunk at reception start and releases it after outgoing payload completion.
Ground sink retains all received chunks with finite configured station storage.
Policy: satisfy deadline and constraints, then fewer relay hops, earlier final arrival, lower lander communications energy.
SYNTHETIC external relay power assumed sufficient only during declared service; battery/base loads not modeled
Ground stations use externally powered service; station battery/base loads are outside the frozen profile.
